inputs.prompt: Photorealistic vertical 9:16 close-up photo of one large classic orange pumpkin, completely uncarved: smooth intact skin with natural ribs and a curly stem. The pumpkin is big in the frame, centered, filling about 75% of the image width and most of the height, sitting on a wooden porch step at night, facing the camera. Dark porch background with a softly blurred warm wall lantern, autumn leaves on the step, shallow depth of field. No carving, no face, no drawing, no candle, no glow, no hands, no people, no text, no watermark.

Edit image 1 (the blank pumpkin on the porch): keep the exact same pumpkin at the exact same size and position in the frame (do not zoom, move or resize it), shape, stem, porch, camera angle, lighting and composition, and carve the person from image 2 into the front of the pumpkin as a clean stencil-style cut-out portrait through the rind, faithful to the person's likeness (face, hair, clothing silhouette, any held object). Do not invent glasses, teeth, or features that are not in image 2. Do not change anything else in image 1. The pumpkin is NOT lit: cut-out holes are dark voids showing the hollow interior, only soft ambient porch light on the outside skin. No candle, no flame, no glow, no smoke, no text, no watermark.

Hyperlapse of real pumpkin carving, sped up like a documentary time-lapse. Locked camera, no camera move. Start on the blank uncarved pumpkin in the first frame. Real hands and a small carving knife enter and cut fast, sawing and punching clean silhouette openings through the rind until the face matches the last frame exactly. Fast cutting pace, visible knife strokes and pumpkin scraps, natural skin texture, real porch at night. Ambient porch light only. Carved openings stay dark empty voids with nothing lit inside. End on the finished silhouette, matching the last frame design, pumpkin, and porch. Do not invent a generic jack-o'-lantern face. No candle, no flame, no fire, no torch, no internal glow, no smoke, no CGI, no plastic look, no morphing. No whip pans, no text, no watermarks.
